description: Paid x402 tool. Match incomplete or conflicting public supplier, location, or organization attributes to trusted master-data candidates. Returns explainable match evidence and never silently chooses an ambiguous entity. Price ID: price.resolve.v1.

entityType.description: One of the v1 entity domains. customer, asset, and person are closed Operator decisions, not gaps; reference data is served by get_reference_data.

inputSchema.description: Input for the paid resolution of identifying attributes to the matching golden-record identity. Mirrors POST /v1/master-data/entities/resolve. At least one of identifiers or attributes must be supplied.

attributes.description: Identifying attribute values keyed by field name, e.g. a name or an address line.

identifiers.description: Known identifiers of the entity being resolved.

system.description: Identifier system the value belongs to.

value.description: The identifier value within its system.
